config.normalizers: Same force, Hessian, third-tensor and density/source-gradient scales as the preceding join audit, evaluated on the reference assembled field. Five one-factor refinements, density and density-gradient identities must pass at every point, including the old outer grid now covered by the exterior provider. The potential-zero difference on the overlap must meet 1e-6 in monopole units. Standalone near-field errors where that provider has zero weight are diagnostic only; no erroneous inactive field is inserted into the actual potential. All source variants and all coordinates are retained.
config.registration: After the failed 80--120 kpc join and the independent order-128 exterior admission from 60 kpc, before evaluating this denser grid. Evaluate one potential with a fixed 60--80 kpc transition at every registered point. Keep all numerical tolerances unchanged and retain every old grid coordinate. Failed prior runs are not reclassified.
config.scope: Finite grid audit of one matched Newtonian potential. This does not validate a production interpolant, the action flux and separate Poisson solve, any new physical gravity card, direct outer-star motion, or astronomical confirmation.
